Billing & payment

How and when you pay.

← Help Center

How do I pay?

Personal accounts and guest bookings pay upfront by bank transfer after booking; we only process the shipment once payment is received. Company accounts can choose upfront payment or request invoice terms. Payment details are sent with the booking confirmation.

Is the website price final?

It is an estimate based on the published rate. The final price follows weighing and measuring, and any situational charge is told to you before you agree.

Is VAT charged?

No. Our prices are not subject to VAT (PPN).

Can I get invoice terms?

Yes, for Company accounts only (PT or CV). Register as Company, upload your NIB and NPWP, and request 7, 14 or 30 day invoice terms. PCW reviews the documents and confirms the terms in writing. Personal accounts always pay upfront.
